title: The Sphere Packing Problem in Dimension 4 and the Twenty-Four-Cell Conjecture
description: The revision preserves the supplied manuscript and adds a protected convex hull that exterior packing centres cannot cut. An explicit volume estimate proves (G) for a family of simultaneous radial and directional perturbations of the D4 roots. The unrestricted case (G) and the remaining cases (C) for 25–28 centres are open.
